title: Duolingo Styleguide
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.browser: Chromium via playwright-core, production build under required subpath
checks.assets: all 10 images and all local fonts loaded
controls: email form validation and local feedback

asset_issues.issue: Initial Python fetches stalled; CloudFront SVGs were gzip encoded.
asset_issues.resolution: Fetched exact source URLs using curl and decoded gzip. Downloader now uses --compressed.

asset_issues.issue: Chromium lacked a fire emoji glyph.
asset_issues.resolution: Bundled Noto Color Emoji from Google Fonts for the specified flame.
Implemented and verified against the full written prompt; no reference extraction.

notes: Only this project was implemented. No agents, other sessions, deployment, or push.
Base path: /motionsites-results/duolingo-styleguide-hero/. All runtime resources are local.
Style-guide action buttons are interaction specimens. Email subscription is a local demo without a backend.
ready means prepared for management-session acceptance, not deployed.
